csv_agency: State of Wisconsin Dept of Trans Div Of Hwys
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Wisconsin , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to provide Design for WisDOT led perpetuation project to replace the pavement of approximately 7.0 miles of IH 43 in Walworth County from STH 50 to USH 12. The pavement including on and off ramps will be replaced. Additional work includes guardrail replacement, culvert pipe repair/replacement, curb ramp replacement, FTMS fiber installation along the corridor, signing, pavement marking replacement and bridge rehabilitation. Consultant design services include drainage, signing, traffic control, signals, lighting, structures, plat development and utility coordination.
